title: SanDisk Ultra microSDXC Card 1TB $135.93 (73% off) Delivered @ Amazon Germany via AU
body:
Deal: SanDisk Ultra microSDXC Card 1TB $135.93 (73% off) Delivered @ Amazon Germany via AU

[Intoxicoligist] Didn't waste any time hitting buy on this one. Flash storage for this price is highly unusual based on what I've seen recently
[AlastorSin] did a quick check and apparently it goes for like $275 or so normally instead of the almost 500 rrp listed.
BUT saying that, this is a ridiculous price anyway for a 1tb recently. Bought 1 as well. Tempted to buy more…
[Intoxicoligist] Na as in I think its legit, but it will sell out fast.
[UncleRico] Nice. Dare I ask, what will you do with them?
[nightelves] He's looking to get into the adult entertainment industry.
[sunnyc] Blackmagic Media Module 8TB
This struggles to capture all that i'm offering
150mbs won't be able to capture even 1 frame
[M27] 150MB/s probably is for read, I think its write speed is super slow.
[sassypants] this is a great deal but no Endurance option. Been waiting for an Endurance card to go on sale for my security camera.
[prankster] same, i've bought them 2 years ago and nowadays its like 2/3 more exy wtf
[sassypants] I bought 3x128gb endurance from digi direct less than 12 months ago. Listed for $25 but they gave me a deal and charged $20 each because it was a 1 month wait time. Now they're at least $40.
[R-Man] For multiple cameras? Why the need for that large storage?
[sassypants] not a 1tb, you're right it's far too big for security cams. Just need a bunch of smaller capacity ones but comparing to the price I paid even just 12 months ago, current prices are hard to stomach.
[R-Man] so true. a while ago i returned a ~$50 micro sd to amazon, thought i didnt need it. when i decided i did need it… it was being sold for about $154 :/ the nintendo mario deal is what saved me last time, it's up again https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/977711
[shiny1] Bought one immediately. Thanks.
Edit: Yep, cancelled. Ah well.
[raritymlp] I wonder what the write speed is like on the 1TB version, I have the 1.5TB and it's so damn slow with 15MB/s write speed, read speed is fine.
[SkyeMG] 1.5tb making those now?!
i know multiple devices support 2tb microsd but they don't exist yet last i checked
[raritymlp] Had mine for almost 2 years in my Macbook Pro.
Got it from this deal here
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/870693
I'm so mad at how expensive flash memory is now.
[SkyeMG] Nice,
which MB do u have ? didn't know they got sd slot or is it in an adaptor ?
[pongky] wow hope some of you got your orders fulfilled!
[TheDukeOfNukem] Wild that the prices are so cooked now that not just this price is considered good, but people are fearing their orders will be cancelled kind of good.
[SamyKn] technically no , for dash (constant write) you need an endurance version imho.
[MrZ] 1TB for a dashcam lolol complete overkill. I have 32GB in mine (my cam is 1080p though).
[abacus] Lots of fake items on Amazon. Check out the $130 6Tb or 8Tb SSD external drives.
